hero_subtitle: Raporo akazamuka k'ihutirwa mu masegonda make. SafeNet imenyesha vuba ibitaro, polisi cyangwa itsinda ryo gukiza hafi nawe — by'ikirenga.
trusted_by: Yizezwa n'abaturage, ibitaro, polisi n'abazimya inkongi
stat1_label: Kuva mu raporo kugeza mu itangazo
how_subtitle: Inzira enye kuva mu raporo kugeza ku gisubizo — bikozwe by'ikirenga
step1_desc: Sobanura akazamuka k'ihutirwa udusangize aho uherereye. Bikwiye iminota nk'igice.
step2_desc: SafeNet ishakisha by'ikirenga ibitaro, polisi cyangwa sitasiyo y'inkongi bya hafi.
step3_desc: Abacunga ibikoresho babona ItangazaMakuru vuba ukoresheje SMS, imeyili na porogaramu.
step4_desc: Kurikirana raporo yawe nk'uko igenda kuva 'Rindiri' → 'Ubufasha buragenda' → 'Byarangiye'.
role_community_desc: Ku muntu wese ukeneye gutanga raporo cyangwa gukurikirana akazamuka k'ihutirwa
role_resource_desc: Ku bitaro, polisi, abazimya inkongi n'amasosiyete yo gukiza
perk_r2: Kwemera cyangwa kwanga ugeze inshuro imwe
perk_r3: Hindura igihe ubona hari nawe nk'uko bigenda
role_admin_desc: Ku bayobozi b'umugi na administrateur ba porogaramu
stories_subtitle: Inkuru z'umuryango SafeNet ikorera i Kigali.
testimonial1_quote: Natanze raporo y'impanuka mu muhanda kandi mu minota mike ibitaro bya hafi byabimenyaga. Uwasabye ubufasha yageze mu minota munsi ya 8. Iri rubuga rirokora ubuzima.
testimonial2_quote: Mbere ya SafeNet, raporo z'ibibazo zaza kuri radiyo - byoroshyeraga gusimburira. Noneho mbona itangazo vuba hamwe n'aho biherereye. Twakuyemo ibibazo 23 ukwezi gushize binyuze muri porogaramu iyi.
testimonial3_quote: Duha amakuru y'igihe turimo kandi sisitemu itwereka akazamuka k'ihutirwa by'ikirenga. Abarwayi batatu b'ihutirwa ukwezi gushize baje binyuze mu butumwa bwa SafeNet.
cta_title: Umuryango wawe ukwiye gusubizwa vuba mu gihe cy'ihutirwa.
cta_subtitle: Birabura ku baturage. Yakozwe ku bantu barinda imibereho.
